# Gladstone Investment Announces Monthly Cash Distributions for October, November and December 2026, and Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates for the Second Fiscal Quarter


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_1c2fc31d5519a6dacd6f91fee74d0ead/gladstoneinvestment/news/2026-10-13_Gladstone_Investment_Announces_Monthly_Cash_449.pdf) October 13, 2026 4:15pm EDT


**MCLEAN, VA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 13, 2026 /**[Gladstone Investment Corporation](https://pr.report/sbtl) (Nasdaq:GAIN) (the "Company") announced today that its board of directors declared the following monthly cash distributions to common stockholders. The Company also announced its plan to report earnings for its second fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026.


***Common Stock:*** $0.08 per share of common stock for each of October, November and December 2026 payable per the table below.


**Record Date**


**Payment Date**


**Cash Distribution**


October 23


October 30


$ 0.08


November 19


November 30


$ 0.08


December 21


December 31


$ 0.08


**Total for the Quarter:**


$ 0.24


The Company offers a dividend reinvestment plan (the "DRIP") to its common stockholders. For more information regarding the DRIP, please visit[www.gladstoneinvestment.com](https://pr.report/sbtm) .


The Company also announced today that it plans to report earnings after the stock market closes on Monday, November 9, 2026, for its second fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss its earnings results. Please call (866) 373-3416 to enter the conference call. An operator will monitor the call and set a queue for questions.


A conference call replay will be available beginning after the call and will be accessible through November 17, 2026. To hear the replay, please dial (877) 660-6853 and use playback conference number 13762360.


The live audio broadcast of the Company's conference call will be available online at[www.gladstoneinvestment.com](https://pr.report/sbtn) . The event will also be archived and available for replay on the Company's website.


**About Gladstone Investment Corporation:**[Gladstone Investment Corporation](https://pr.report/sbto) is a publicly traded business development company that seeks to make secured debt and equity investments in lower middle market businesses in the United States in connection with acquisitions, changes in control, and recapitalizations. Information on the business activities of all the Gladstone funds can be found at[www.gladstonecompanies.com](https://pr.report/sbtp) .


**Investor Relations Inquiries** : Please visit[www.gladstonecompanies.com](https://pr.report/sbtq) or (703) 287-5893.
